about: Index of the skills in this repo. Claude reads this file to choose skills for a project; see INSTALL.md. 'tier' is core (useful in almost any software project), recommended (install when the signals match), or optional (install only when asked or clearly needed). 'signals' are things to look for in the target project.

skills.name: ai-todo
skills.summary: Keeps AI-TODO.md: Claude's plan and log (in progress, next, blocked, done) so any session can resume.
signals: owner wants to see what Claude is doing

skills.name: human-todo
skills.summary: Keeps HUMAN-TODO.md: the owner's checklist of manual steps (logins, secrets, decisions, merges) with exact instructions.
signals: external accounts or services to set up

skills.name: handoff
skills.summary: On 'handoff', writes handoff.md (goal, state, active files, changes, failed attempts, next steps) so a fresh session continues.

skills.name: using-agent-skills
skills.summary: Meta-skill: how to discover and pick the right skill for the task at hand. Install whenever several addyosmani skills are installed.

skills.name: context-engineering
skills.summary: Sets up rules files (CLAUDE.md) and context for a project; fixes degraded agent output.

skills.name: idea-refine
skills.summary: Turns a vague idea into a sharp concept through divergent then convergent thinking; writes to docs/ideas/.

skills.name: interview-me
skills.summary: One-question-at-a-time interview to find what the user actually wants before any plan or code.

skills.name: planning-and-task-breakdown
skills.summary: Breaks a spec or requirements into ordered, implementable tasks; spots parallel work.

skills.name: constraint-driven-development
skills.summary: Writes the quality bar to CONSTRAINTS.md (coverage, perf, a11y thresholds) and catches agents lowering it (skipped tests, ts-ignore).

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.summary: Red-green-refactor loop for any logic change or bug fix.
signals: any codebase with tests, or that should have them

skills.name: debugging-and-error-recovery
skills.summary: Systematic root-cause debugging when tests fail, builds break, or behaviour is unexpected.

skills.name: code-review-and-quality
skills.summary: Multi-axis review of a diff or PR before merging.

skills.name: git-workflow-and-versioning
skills.summary: Branching, atomic commits, PRs, conflicts, releases, semver and changelogs.

skills.name: source-driven-development
skills.summary: Checks implementation decisions against official framework/library docs; avoids outdated patterns.
signals: fast-moving frameworks (Next.js, Expo, new major versions)

skills.name: api-and-interface-design
skills.summary: Stable REST/GraphQL APIs, module boundaries and type contracts between frontend and backend.

skills.name: security-and-hardening
skills.summary: OWASP Top Ten, auth/session safety, input handling, dependency audits, privacy (GDPR/CCPA).

skills.name: performance-optimization
skills.summary: Frontend, backend and database performance: Core Web Vitals, N+1 queries, profiling.

skills.name: observability-and-instrumentation
skills.summary: Logging, metrics, tracing and alerting so production behaviour is diagnosable.

skills.name: deprecation-and-migration
skills.summary: Removing or replacing systems and APIs; zero-downtime schema changes (expand/contract).

skills.name: ci-cd-and-automation
skills.summary: Build and deploy pipelines, quality gates, test runners in CI, deployment strategies (any CI provider).
signals: CI config exists or is planned

skills.name: github-actions-templates
skills.summary: Ready GitHub Actions workflows for test, build and deploy.

skills.name: frontend-ui-engineering
skills.summary: Accessible (WCAG), responsive, production-quality UI: components, layouts, state.

skills.name: browser-testing-with-devtools
skills.summary: Inspects DOM, console, network and performance in a real browser via Chrome DevTools MCP.

skills.name: vercel-react-best-practices
skills.summary: Vercel's React/Next.js performance rules (waterfalls, bundle size, server components, data fetching).
signals: package.json depends on react or next

skills.name: vercel-composition-patterns
skills.summary: React composition patterns: compound components, no boolean-prop sprawl, React 19 APIs.

skills.name: vercel-react-native-skills
skills.summary: React Native/Expo performance: lists, animations, native modules, fonts, imports.
signals: package.json depends on react-native or expo

skills.name: expo-router
skills.summary: Expo Router navigation: file-based routes, stacks, tabs, modals, sheets, headers, search.
signals: app/ directory in an Expo app

skills.name: expo-native-ui
skills.summary: Native-feeling Expo screens: Apple HIG, semantic colors, native controls, SF Symbols, media, effects.

skills.name: expo-dev-client
skills.summary: Build and distribute Expo development clients (local or TestFlight) when Expo Go isn't enough.

skills.name: neon
skills.summary: Neon overview: Postgres, Auth, object storage, functions, AI gateway; CLI/MCP setup; branch-first workflow.

skills.name: neon-postgres
skills.summary: Neon Postgres: pooled vs direct connections, migrations, branching, autoscaling, replicas, search.

skills.name: neon-postgres-branches
skills.summary: Choosing and creating Neon branches for testing migrations, per-PR branches, schema-only branches.
signals: Neon plus CI or preview environments

skills.name: stripe-best-practices
skills.summary: Stripe integration decisions: Checkout vs PaymentIntents, billing/subscriptions, Connect, tax, webhooks, key security.

skills.name: find-skills
skills.summary: Searches the public skills ecosystem (npx skills, skills.sh) for skills this repo doesn't have.
signals: project needs a technology none of these skills cover

templates.name: project-specs
templates.summary: Maps the project's spec documents (PRD, architecture, data model, API, security) and its non-negotiable rules, so Claude reads them before coding.
signals: project has a docs/ or specs folder with product/architecture documents

templates.name: plan-feature
templates.summary: /plan-feature <description>: writes a spec-backed plan (scope, data, API, security, tests, slices) to docs/plans/.

templates.name: spec-review
templates.summary: /spec-review [branch|PR|path]: reviews changes against the project's security and definition-of-done rules and writes the completion report.
signals: project has a security or rules document

external.name: emilkowalski/skills
external.summary: Emil Kowalski's design-engineering skills: UI design, animations (web and Expo), Apple-style design, animation reviews. Not copied here; installed from the author. See Frontend.md.
external.note: The author recommends using these case by case (for example to review animations) rather than always on.
